sudo mysql --defaults-extra-file=/root/.mysql-reporting/my.cnf --table -e "SHOW SESSION STATUS LIKE 'Ssl_cipher'; SELECT c.id AS customer_id,c.name,o.id AS order_id,CAST(o.amount AS CHAR) AS amount FROM branch_orders.customers c JOIN branch_orders.orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id ORDER BY o.id; SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_count,CAST(SUM(amount) AS CHAR) AS exact_total FROM branch_orders.orders;"
set +e
out=$(sudo mysql --defaults-extra-file=/root/.mysql-reporting/my.cnf -e "UPDATE branch_orders.orders SET amount=1.00 WHERE id=101" 2>&1)
rc=$?
set -e
printf 'post_restart_update_attempt_rc=%s\n%s\n' "$rc" "$out"
[ "$rc" -ne 0 ]

set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /etc/redhat-release
uname -r
rpm -q mysql
sudo mysql --defaults-extra-file=/root/.mysql-reporting/my.cnf --table -e "SELECT CURRENT_USER() AS reporting_account; SHOW SESSION STATUS LIKE 'Ssl_cipher'; SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM branch_orders.customers; SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_count,CAST(SUM(amount) AS CHAR) AS exact_total FROM branch_orders.orders;"
